name: Coelius Capital
identity_check: Confirmed as Coelius Capital (coelius.vc; site title 'Home - Coelius Capital', tagline 'Entrepreneurial early stage capital for technology startups'), the solo-GP early-stage firm of Zach Coelius (linked from the site's footer via his LinkedIn/X), investing in B2B/B2B2C startups with $200k-1m checks. EDGAR shows its main fund vehicle Coelius Capital II, LP with a San Francisco address (c/o Coelius Capital), an AngelList rolling fund (Coelius Capital Rolling Fund, LP, series A1-G1) and AngelList SPV series of Coelius Capital, LP. Press (TechCrunch, Fortune, The Real Deal) names 'Coelius Capital' in rounds. Database pages also call it 'Coelius Enterprises'. Not coelius.com (a Spanish campsite), not the Swedish asset manager Coeli, and not Long Angle's 'Coelius Capital II SPV' (an LP feeder into the fund).

thesis_text.value: Solo-GP early-stage firm built around founder Zach Coelius that writes roughly $200K-$1M checks into B2B and B2B2C technology startups whose unconventional ('weird') ideas already show customer validation, before metrics are obvious. It uses a large AngelList backer community for diligence, favours SaaS, enterprise, fintech, data and AI, and avoids crypto/web3, bio, chips, security and hard sciences.

open_items: coelius.vc did not respond on 2026-10-30 (connection refused / timed out); site facts come from a Wayback snapshot dated 2026-06-13 whose content was last modified 2020-09-01, so the 34-logo portfolio grid and wording are old. coelius.com is an unrelated Spanish campsite.
No application form or apply URL: the site asks founders to email a deck or a paragraph to the founder's address (not recorded). application_url left out.
No company LinkedIn page found; the site links only to Zach Coelius's personal LinkedIn and X profiles. linkedin left out.

Fund I not verified: leads cite '$45M (2020-07-15)' and search snippets mention a first fund with '$45 million in new assets' and Industry Ventures as LP, but the podcast pages carrying this (strongsuit.libsyn.com, metacast) returned 404/403. EDGAR full-text search for 2019-2020 shows only AngelList SPV series and the rolling fund (from Oct 2020). DevCuration says the firm launched in July 2020.

SEC EDGAR Form D documents (www.sec.gov/Archives) refused the declared User-Agent, so offering amounts for Coelius Capital II, LP and the rolling fund series were not read; data.sec.gov submissions JSON and the efts full-text search did respond and are used for names, addresses and filing dates only.

Rolling fund: EDGAR lists quarterly series A1-A4 (2020-21), B1-B4 (2021-22), C1-C4 (2022-23), D1-D4 (2023-24), E1-E4 (2024-25), F1-F4 (2025-26) and G1 (Form D 2026-10-06); sizes not read. Search snippets (not a fetched page) say the AngelList page calls it a sidecar to 'Coelius Capital 2, a $33.3m early stage fund'; the AngelList page is client-rendered and archived copies were blocked.

Other EDGAR vehicles not recorded as funds: dozens of AngelList-administered SPVs ('XX Fund I, a series of Coelius Capital, LP' and '... a series of Coelius Funds, LP', 2020-2025), 'Coelius Capital SPV, LP' (Form D 2024-02-02), and 'Coelius Capital II SPV, a series of Long Angle Investments LLC' (a third-party LP feeder into Fund II, 2021-2026).

Database LP list (Gilion, unconfirmed): Industry Ventures, Chris Sacca, Nimble Ventures, Ben Nasarin and Tenacity Ventures, Karen Page, Frederic Kerrest. Claims of an unaudited 28.8% gross IRR (Oct 2024) and a 4,000+ member AngelList syndicate come from the DevCuration blog only.
Only 2 recorded rounds fall in the last 24 months (Known Dec 2025, Metaview Series B Jun 2025); 8 rounds recorded in total, going back to Feb 2021. No 2026 round naming Coelius was found.

Rounds seen but not recorded: NiaHealth CAD 5.75M seed (Jun 2025) names 'Zach Coelius' personally, not the firm (Calgary.Tech); Learnerbly $10M Series A (Dec 2021) lists 'Zach Coelius (Coelius Capital)' among angels (TechCrunch); JotPsych $5M seed (Jul 2025) is attributed to Coelius by Caplight, but HIT Consultant and Goodwin name only Base10; Smart Access Series A (Mar 2025, CB Insights hint) and HEALTHREE Series A (Feb 2026, Tracxn hint) not confirmed on any round page; Evernow, ARTA, Workshop, Mozart Data, NotiSphere, Sinai Technologies (Fundable list) not checked.

stated_sectors come from VC Sheet (database); the firm's own site says only 'B2B or B2B2C'. The lead's 'Fintech' focus matches VC Sheet; fintech-type names on the site's logo grid include Mercury, Facet Wealth, Finexio and YayPay, and recorded rounds include OpenEnvoy and Billy.
Nothing found on investing in Indian founders or requiring a US entity; VC Sheet lists 'USA' as geography, but recorded portfolio includes London-based Metaview.

HQ: the EDGAR address for Coelius Capital II, LP is a San Francisco mailbox (447 Sutter St, PMB); the 'Seattle, WA' / 'Lynnwood, WA' addresses on rolling-fund and SPV Form Ds belong to the AngelList fund administrator, not the firm.
Company websites, HQs and founding years not stated for Known, Billy, Twine and Snack on the pages read.
